# EBC Mussoorie (Everest Base Camp Mussoorie)

> Luxury glamping resort in Mussoorie, Uttarakhand, India, with forest tents, luxury cottages and a private villa at Park Estate, Hathipaon Road. Home to Park Café and The Den, a private event venue.

## Key facts
- Address: Everest Base Camp Mussoorie, Park Estate, Hathipaon Road, Mussoorie, Uttarakhand 248179, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 91190 01126
- Email: info@ebcmussoorie.com
- Website: https://www.ebcmussoorie.com/
- Check-in 2:00 PM, check-out 11:00 AM
- Pets are welcome (please inform the resort in advance)
- Included with every room: breakfast for two, evening bonfire access, a guided morning nature walk, Wi-Fi and free parking
- Distance: about 280 km (5.5–6.5 hours by road) from Delhi; 35 km from Dehradun; Jolly Grant Airport about 55 km
- Corporate groups: 8 to 48 guests
- Booking: https://live.ipms247.com/booking/book-rooms-everestbasecamp

## Rooms and nightly rates (from, plus GST)
- [The Andrew's Villa](https://www.ebcmussoorie.com/rooms/the-andrews-villa/): flagship private villa with its own entrance, terrace and bonfire area. From ₹20,000
- [Twin Luxury Cottages](https://www.ebcmussoorie.com/rooms/twin-luxury-cottages/): two interconnected cottages for families or two couples. From ₹20,000
- [Zenith Luxury Cottage](https://www.ebcmussoorie.com/rooms/zenith-luxury-cottage/): signature freestanding forest cottage with a private veranda. From ₹18,000
- [The Surveyor](https://www.ebcmussoorie.com/rooms/the-surveyor/): spacious suite with a large private sit-out. From ₹16,000
- [The Surveyor Suite](https://www.ebcmussoorie.com/rooms/the-surveyor-suite/): premium glamping tent with a private deck in the forest canopy. From ₹14,000
- [The Glamper](https://www.ebcmussoorie.com/rooms/the-glamper/): luxury canvas tent with a private deck. From ₹12,000
- [The Camper](https://www.ebcmussoorie.com/rooms/the-camper/): compact forest glamping unit. From ₹10,000

## Experiences
- Forest walks and nature trails, bird watching, stargazing sessions, bonfire evenings, picnics and barbecues
- Day trips to Kempty Falls, Dhanaulti, Lal Tibba, Camel's Back Road and Mall Road
- Park Café: multi-cuisine café with dishes from the Garhwal hills
